text:
Rae (partnerships): Partner ask: Datadog SI wants a focused OTLP+metrics QA on our private GPU appliance before we finalize the marketplace tile. Can we do ~40m next Tue AM? They want trace sampling, cache eviction visibility, and alert firing tested.
Alex (eng-runtime): yes. Need partner container, ingest-only key, and the trimmed dashboard JSON. Also confirm whether they want trace->log correlation tested (W3C headers).
Marco (datadog-partner): will drop dashboard bundle + collector config today. We'll include a small log-forwarder snippet to test trace->log linking. Sampling: 1/10 baseline, 1/1 for error traces.
Priya (eng-ml): to exercise eviction counters run mixed seqs [64,512,1024] and a couple of long spans. Partner will host the model binary.
June (product): single success line for run doc: "Dashboard tiles populate within 30s, trace->log links work, alert triggers on synthetic 5% error burst, exporter RSS <20% growth over 30m." Legal needs 24h on any quote.
Alex (eng-runtime): run plan: 1) quick staging smoke (15m) 2) tune exporter flags (batch_size, linger_ms, max_queue) 3) partner rack run 4) capture dashboard snapshot + perf strip. Who owns press snapshot?
Rae (partnerships): partnerships owns press snapshot and partner quote. Eng supplies perf slices and a 2-line blurb for the marketplace tile.
Marco (datadog-partner): sending demo creds with embargo; will attach the collector config and dashboard JSON link in a follow-up.
Alex (eng-runtime): quick sanity curl for staging once image is up:
```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @tiny_trace.pbf
# expect 200 and "accepted" in exporter log
```
ci-bot: build redwood/embedded-exporter:v1.6.4 passed  deploy when ready (ci/3500001111).
Priya (eng-ml): test knobs: REDWOOD_MAX_SEQ=1024 REDWOOD_CACHE_TTL=60s and mixed batch sizes to hit eviction metrics.
Rae (partnerships): actions: Marco to drop dashboard+collector config EOD; Alex/Priya to run staging smoke Mon AM; partner run Tue AM. I'll loop in comms and legal for embargo and quote signoff.
June (product): please add the 1-line wiring blurb for customers in the tile docs: e.g., "Set DD_API_KEY in your collector, enable trace->log correlation, and import our dashboard JSON."
Alex (eng-runtime): will post 3-line wiring snippet after staging. Will also attach perf strip here post-run.
Rae (partnerships): thanks everyone, tagging back when partner slot confirmed. :thumbsup:
